data.one_liner: A Dart client for interacting with the Ollama API.
data.what_it_does: A Dart client for interacting with the Ollama inference engine API. It provides an easy-to-use interface for generating text completions, chat responses, and embeddings, with support for streaming responses.
use_when: You need to integrate Ollama language models into your Dart or Flutter application.
You want to generate text completions, chat responses, or embeddings via an Ollama server.
avoid_when: You need on-device LLM inference that runs completely independently of an external Ollama server.
strengths: Supports chat responses, text completions, and embeddings
Allows customizable model parameters and custom base URLs
weaknesses: Requires a running Ollama server instance to function
